sessions.goal: Understand the brief, design the DB schema, then build the entry API, AI layer, result page, admin dashboard and entry form (sessions ran 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-20)
sessions.kept: AI layer architecture and prompt template with <story> isolation, mock moderation provider, Prisma entries/entry_events schema structure, nanoid slug generator, and admin authentication cookie logic.
sessions.changed: Added missing events back-relation on Entry model in schema.prisma, added client-side character count and inspiration chips to EntryForm, and strengthened error handling in API routes.
sessions.rejected: Rejected India-only (+91) phone restriction in favor of a flexible 10-13 digit regex, and rejected exposing internal sequential database IDs in result URLs.

mistakes_caught.what: Prisma schema had EntryEvent.entry relation but Entry had no opposite events field
mistakes_caught.how: Noticed while reading the schema; confirmed with `npx prisma validate`

mistakes_caught.what: Forgot the required landing page and entry form entirely and moved on to API, AI and admin
mistakes_caught.how: Noticed that there was no way for a user to fill the form and asked for it

mistakes_caught.what: normalizeContact let one phone number through in several formats (9876543210, +919876543210, 09876543210), so the duplicate check could be bypassed
mistakes_caught.how: Surfaced when I asked the AI to explain the function; fixed by stripping non-digits, trimming leading country codes, and documenting limitations in README

sessions.goal: Next.js 16 Upgrade, Complete UI/UX Overhaul, Dark Mode Theme Bugfix, Security Hardening, and Upstash Redis Distributed Rate Limiting
sessions.kept: Navbar, Footer, ShareActions components, collectible postcard layout, and Upstash Redis rate limiting with local memory fallback.
sessions.changed: Removed conflicting prefers-color-scheme dark query in globals.css to fix unreadable black-on-black cards; updated async params/searchParams and RouteContext for Next.js 16.
sessions.rejected: Rejected exposing raw IP addresses in database (used SHA-256 hash instead); rejected hardcoded Redis requirement (provided seamless in-memory fallback).

mistakes_caught.what: Dark mode media query in globals.css made cards unreadable black-on-black in dark mode OS settings
mistakes_caught.how: Visual inspection on dark mode device; fixed by pinning to warm chai palette (#FAF7F2)

mistakes_caught.what: useEffect in OverrideControls had missing closeModal dependency warning
mistakes_caught.how: Caught by ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps; fixed with useCallback
